voiceover: Yesterday. LSG vs RR. Lucknow set 220. Rajasthan needed 221 to win. After the powerplay — 6 overs done — score was 71 for 0. Needed 150 from 84 balls. Required rate nearly 11. Every fan watching said: too far behind. Our live model said: 72 percent for RR. Why? Zero wickets down. Ten wickets in hand. Enough balls to build. The score was showing the past. The model was reading the resources. Over 7: first wicket fell. Model dropped to 44 percent — showing exactly how much each wicket matters. Over 11: 137 for 1. Model: 90 percent. RR in control. Over 12: 166 for 1. Model: 99 percent. Match done. RR won. The model called it at over 6, when the score still looked against them.
